item.title: Version 1.5.54
item.description:
🎉 v1.5.54 Update

  • ✨ Built-in Text Transformations
    - Added built-in text transformations for case conversion, naming conventions, whitespace cleanup, line sorting, duplicate line removal, and text reversal.
    - Added a Text Transform folder so the new actions stay organized instead of crowding the main action list.
  • 🔧 Folder Context Regex
    - Folders can now use Context (Regex), so action groups appear only when selected text matches the folder condition.
  • 🎨 Action Settings Polish
    - Improved built-in action labels in settings with readable names like Copy, Large Type, and Spell Check while preserving the existing internal templates.
    - Added a subtle folder dot indicator in the new settings preview and floating panel.
